propositions: Multiple duplicate policy frozensets (_READS_INIT_ONLY, _WRITES_FULL, _BRIDGE, _HIDDEN_ALIASES, etc.) and hand-authored command selection ladders must be deleted and replaced with a single registry-derived policy authority.

Every command intercept route must carry exactly one lazy handler, argv adapter, and init policy to dispatch through a single _execute.execute entry point, with generated help and reference artifacts byte-identical on second render.

Whole-route and whole-parser behavior must remain identical across all command families (reconcile, review-plan, enrich, config, verify, identity, audit) with unchanged exit codes, output, init policies, and capability posture after cutover.
All source modules must stay under 800 lines with no mechanically-split files under 100 lines, lint/type/complexity gates must pass, and no persisted ticket/event/bridge/binding format changes.
